scripts.build: npm run api:generate && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && npm run api:check && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && npm run test --workspace @xobject/server && npm run test --workspace @xobject/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && npm run build --workspace @xobject/web && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/server/src/main.ts
scripts.admin:create: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/server/src/cli.ts create-admin
scripts.dev:seed: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/server/src/cli.ts seed-demo --confirm-local-demo
scripts.db:init: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/server/src/cli.ts initialize
scripts.db:reset: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/server/src/cli.ts reset-development --confirm-dev-reset
scripts.measure:permissions: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/measure-permissions.ts
scripts.measure:v1-paths: npm run build --workspace @xobject/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/measure-v1-paths.ts
